story.title: About Tekillah
story.body: Behind every great celebration lie countless details and difficult choices. Tekillah began from our belief that moments of joy should never be spoiled by the burden of planning. The name draws from the Arabic concept of trust and reliance — to be the partner you lean on to orchestrate your most beautiful nights.
story.secondary: Tekillah is the first luxury Saudi platform that merges the intelligence of planning with the art of execution. We give you peace of mind so you can savour every second, while we paint the full picture behind the scenes.
story.imgAlt: Soft-focus luxury fabric with delicate gold detail

terms.tosIntro: Please read these Terms carefully before using Tekillah. They govern your access to and use of our platform, including all bookings, payments, and content.

tosSections.title: 1. About Tekillah
tosSections.body: Tekillah is a Saudi-based marketplace that connects customers with verified event vendors — wedding halls, catering, photography, decor, transportation and more. We facilitate discovery, booking, secure payment, and post-event reviews.

tosSections.title: 2. Bookings & Escrow
tosSections.body: Bookings are confirmed once the customer pays through our secure escrow system. Funds are held by Tekillah until the service is delivered, and are then released to the vendor net of platform fees and applicable VAT (15%). Escrow protects both parties from non-delivery and disputes.

tosSections.title: 3. Vendor Verification
tosSections.body: Vendors must provide accurate business information, a valid IBAN certificate, and a Commercial Register or Freelance Work Document. All submissions are reviewed by Tekillah's compliance team before going live. Vendors that misrepresent their business may be permanently suspended.

tosSections.title: 4. Customer Conduct & Content
tosSections.body: Customers and vendors agree to behave professionally. Reviews, replies, and any user-generated content must comply with our content guidelines. Tekillah reserves the right to remove content or suspend accounts that violate these standards.

tosSections.title: 5. Refunds & Disputes
tosSections.body: Refunds and disputes are handled in line with the escrow rules and Saudi consumer-protection law. If a vendor cancels a confirmed booking, the customer is eligible for a full refund. For other cases, contact our support team within 14 days of the event.

tosSections.title: 6. Fees & VAT
tosSections.body: Tekillah charges a transparent platform fee on each booking, and applies VAT at the statutory rate (currently 15%). All fees are shown clearly at checkout before payment is confirmed.

tosSections.title: 7. Updates to These Terms
tosSections.body: These Terms may be updated from time to time. We'll notify users of material changes by email or in-app notification. Continued use of Tekillah after an update constitutes acceptance of the new Terms.

terms.privacyIntro: This Privacy Policy explains how Tekillah collects, uses, and safeguards your data in line with Saudi PDPL and international best practice.

privacySections.title: 1. Data We Collect
privacySections.body: We collect only what we need to operate the platform: account info (name, email, phone), booking history, payment metadata (we never store full card numbers), and vendor onboarding documents.

privacySections.title: 2. How We Use Your Data
privacySections.body: We use your data to operate the marketplace, process payments, send transactional notifications (booking, payment, review activity), enforce platform safety, and comply with Saudi tax and accounting laws.

privacySections.title: 3. Vendor Documents
privacySections.body: Vendor banking documents (IBAN certificate) and business documents (Commercial Register / Freelance Work Document) are stored in private, encrypted storage and are accessible only to authorised admin reviewers.

privacySections.title: 4. Sharing With Third Parties
privacySections.body: We never sell your personal data. We share data only with payment partners (Mada, STC Pay, Apple Pay providers) strictly for processing transactions, and with Saudi tax authorities as required by law.

privacySections.title: 5. Your Rights
privacySections.body: You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data. You can also request a copy of your data. Contact our support team to exercise these rights.

privacySections.title: 6. Retention
privacySections.body: We retain transaction and tax records as required by Saudi tax and accounting laws (typically up to 10 years). Account data is deleted on request, except where retention is legally required.

privacySections.title: 7. Cookies & Analytics
privacySections.body: Cookies and analytics are used only to improve performance and detect abuse — never for third-party advertising or behavioural tracking.
